heading: ## Unit 8 ·

parts.scope: The unit framing (Mar'tu / Lucky / Oogrish), then the Refactor set (T-HCL "The Hard-Coded Ledger"), the Control Flow set (T-CF-1, T-CF-2, T-CF-3) and the Lists set (T-L-1, T-L-2, T-L-3) — each core challenge plus its advanced variant (variant_of) — exactly as the curriculum's Unit 8 table describes

The Dictionaries set (T-D-1, T-D-2, T-D-3) and the Loops set (T-Lo-1, T-Lo-2, T-Lo-3), each core challenge plus its advanced variant (variant_of), exactly as the curriculum's Unit 8 table describes; note T-D-1a loops and opens after Unit 6
The Functions set (T-F-1, T-F-2, T-F-3) and Write your own checks (T-Own), each core challenge plus its advanced variant (variant_of), and the cheatsheet "How to read a test table"

slips: hard-coding the visible test's answer instead of computing it (return 22) — hidden labeled tests must catch it; < vs <= at the exact boundary (exactly enough counts); forgetting the empty case (empty wall, empty roster → the stated default; IndexError on wall[-1] of an empty list; ZeroDivisionError for the average); returning the wrong type (a string where True/False is wanted, "True" in quotes); printing instead of returning; changing the list passed in when a new list was asked for (and the reverse); a KeyError for an unknown spell instead of returning 0; tie-breaking wrong; calling the effect function with () when passing it, or not calling it at all; asserts that pass on a wrong function (weak checks); reading the test table backwards (input vs expected).
earlierNote: Units 1-2 are shipped (in this folder). Units 3 (Functions I), 4 (Lists), 5 (Dictionaries) and 6 (Loops) are verified in staging and copied into this folder. Unit 7 (Functions II) may still be in another staging dir; if it is not in this folder, its concepts come from concept_map.json (prefixes u07a, u07b, u07c). This unit is OPTIONAL (every item optional, challenge kind, support="light"). Each set may only use tokens taught by its unlock point (see the curriculum's unlock-ceiling table): T-HCL Unit 1 only; Control Flow Units 1-3; Lists Units 1-4; Dictionaries Units 1-5 (T-D-1a Units 1-6); Loops Units 1-6; Functions and T-Own Units 1-7.
verifyNote: Fix every Unit 8 error until 0 errors; with concept_map.json moved aside any u07 concepts may be missing, so for errors that are ONLY 'concept not introduced yet' for tokens the plan gives to u07a/u07b/u07c, restore the map and re-run with it instead, and report those tokens (they get cross-checked when Unit 7 ships). Also confirm every set respects its unlock ceiling.
extra: Format (read the repo's FORMAT.md and the challenge items in earlier units, e.g. Unit 3's Lucky's Supply Run): kind challenge, support="light", a signature, a short in-world prompt, a test table with 2-3 visible tests plus hidden LABELED tests, and an advanced variant per core challenge via variant_of. If FORMAT.md has no variant_of or test-table field, do NOT invent fields: model the advanced variant as a separate optional challenge item whose title/summary names the core one, and model the test table with checks (each hidden test is a named check with a labeled message), and list in your report what site support would make it nicer. Campaign links: T-CF-1a hold-the-barrier logic, T-CF-3 skill checks with Dumb Luck, T-D spell-book and nested reads, T-F-3a spell["spell_function"](caster), T-Own reading check messages. CONVENTIONS from the Unit 2 walkthrough fixes: "Start like this" hints go LAST, never hint 1, and the last hint's line must be in the solution; never use worksheet-derived names or "Tester" in check data; invented Tor names only.
